_venice_notes.venice_parameters: Inject into any chat request body to control Venice features
_venice_notes.system_prompt_control: Set include_venice_system_prompt=false to keep full prompt authority
_venice_notes.web_search: enable_web_search: off|on|auto — or use model suffix syntax: model:enable_web_search=auto
_venice_notes.web_scraping: enable_web_scraping=true scrapes up to 5 URLs from the user message
_venice_notes.x_search: enable_x_search=true for Grok models — uses xAI native web+Twitter search
_venice_notes.thinking_control: strip_thinking_response removes <think> blocks; disable_thinking turns reasoning off entirely
_venice_notes.prompt_caching: prompt_cache_key routes to same backend for cache hits across turns
_venice_notes.cursor_prefix: Prefix claude-* models with venice- in Cursor to prevent Anthropic format rewrite
